messages:
mike: Heads up — we're scheduled to unpin SDK/runtime v2.9 -> v3.0 on hosted next Wed at 03:00 UTC. Can we gate this? Customer validator is failing on prod embeddings in EU. @henrietta @leo

deploy-bot: Scheduled unpin: runtime-sdk v2.9 -> v3.0. Window: 2026-05-14T03:00Z. To request a hold run: `/deploybot hold unpin 6578523456 reason:\"compat-fail\" approvers:@henrietta`

henrietta: don't unpin. we're seeing failing longseq rerank in eu-region; reproducer points to a kv-cache mismatch after optimizer kernel change. triaging now.

leo: I can confirm. Short-term mitigation: we can soft-pin eu-region back to v2.9 for 24h to buy time for a hotfix.

anya: +1 to soft-pin. What's the deploybot command for region-scoped pins? worried about overlapping canary rollouts.

mike: Can someone run a canary smoke in eu/dedicated? use: `./scripts/canary_smoke.sh --model llama3q --region eu` and paste results here.

leo: ran canary: 10/10 success for short sequences; 2/50 token mismatch on longseq rerank. logs snip: ```TRACE kvcache mismatch at step 42
model: llama3q-q.fast
runtime: sdk-2.9
``` (can't attach full log in thread)

deploy-bot: Hold placed by henrietta on unpin 6578523456. Expires in 24h. Reason: compat-fail longseq eu. Approvers: henrietta, leo.

mike: OK. draft rollback plan if patch isn't ready before expiry: (1) limit unpin to non-EU regions, (2) re-route EU traffic to a dedicated pool pinned to v2.9, (3) prepare customer comms & postmortem ticket.

henrietta: +1. I'll open a release note: "SDK 3.0 runtime unpin paused — long-sequence KV-cache incompatibility in EU; hotfix ETA ~12h."

leo: starting bisect on the kernel selection changes introduced in 3.0. @anya can you validate quantized execution paths once I have a suspect commit?

anya: on it. will run quant-path sanity tests and post results in the morning.

mike: Thanks all. keeping this thread as the single source of truth for decisions. :thumbsup:

sre-oncall-bot: Alert: #prod-llama3q-eu fired at 02:14 UTC — linked incident INC-2026-412.
